'''April 2001 Greeneville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at B and C Comics and Collectibles, Greeneville, Tennessee on 28 April 2001. [[Thomas Kelley]] won it. It is known from Thomas Kelley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2186">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-greeneville-tn-4-28-01d2186/ greeneville-tn-4-28-01], DeckTech (Thomas "ladojrs" Kelley, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-greeneville-tn-4-28-01d2186/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' B and C Comics and Collectibles, Greeneville, Tennessee
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Kelley]]
